description: Source code defining the LabelSet type and associated methods for handling label collections in Prometheus.

classes.name: LabelSet
classes.description: A map-based collection of label name and value pairs used in Prometheus metrics.

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Checks whether all label names and values in the set are valid.

methods.name: Equal
methods.description: Determines if two LabelSets have identical key/value pairs.

methods.name: Before
methods.description: Compares two LabelSets to determine ordering based on label count and values.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of the LabelSet.

methods.name: Merge
methods.description: Non-destructively merges two LabelSets into a new one.

methods.name: Fingerprint
methods.description: Returns a fingerprint hash of the LabelSet.

methods.name: FastFingerprint
methods.description: Returns a faster, less collision-resistant fingerprint hash.

methods.name: UnmarshalJSON
methods.description: Custom JSON unmarshaling for LabelSet, validating label names.
